title: H01 human-reference topographic search
purpose: Current diagnosis; donor response, transfer, circuit and population subtrees can be active simultaneously.
contract: Exact count; 1 ms timing and recovery delays; 1 mV voltage; 0.05 ms spike phases. No trace alignment or pooled override. Usable-tier separate.
holdouts: Released/spent: I 0.23 nA; E sweeps 53 and 55. Still sealed in this snapshot: E sweep 54 (330 pA), I Noise1 sweep 48. No holdout opened by this artifact.
limits: No simulations, fitting, morphology edits, or revival of stopped campaigns. Open/blocked leaves require separately registered and bounded experiments.

methods.meaning: Topographic diagnosis asks what is happening; do not begin with a root-cause label.
Binary questions cover all remaining possibilities and are quick, unambiguous and cheap; do not repeat the same split consecutively.
Retain the search as an explicit tree; classify the observation before selecting the decomposition.
Functional Isolation: split the serial path and ask at which boundary the contrast remains.
Structural Dissection: retain the complementary subsystem, interactions, and each written split.
Distinguish physical/mathematical constraints from man-made requirements. Use voltage/current and charge balance at electrical boundaries; no absolute-truth label for assumptions.
